traditional: No classical doctrine: Neptune is a modern planet unknown to traditional astrology. Read from the modern and cyclic layers; treat this contact as a slow, generational background tone.
modern: Feelings meet imagination and dissolution. A need for escape and reverie, high sensitivity, and compassion. The sextile makes this a natural strength: Imaginative and receptive; help seems to arrive from others. The growth edge is not to coast on the ease.

cyclic.waxing: A chance to organize feeling and imagination into a new form; it must be actively taken up.
cyclic.waning: Reorganize and share what feeling and imagination have taught; communicate the insight.

business: An opening in this area. Strong for imaginative work; protect boundaries and energy.
shadow: The ease lets moodiness and over-need and illusion and escapism go unchecked, or the opening pass unused.
arcApplying: A supportive opening becomes available; offered, not automatic.
arcSeparating: The opening closes; unused, it passes.
base: A subtle feeling can become easier to hear when it is not forced to produce a complete explanation immediately.

readerCopy.body: A subtle feeling can become easier to hear when it is not forced to produce a complete explanation immediately. When the Moon sextiles Neptune, sensitivity and intuition cooperate, helping needs, impressions, and emotional undercurrents become more noticeable. You may notice the feeling before you have language for it, and that does not require turning it into a conclusion yet. A little time can reveal what the signal is actually pointing toward.
